picks.catalyst: Put mirror armed on the levels written at 10:17. The morning filed chips as the month's coolest theme and their +2% gap as a read-through of NVDA's beat; NVDA was sold from the bell on that beat (159.23 -> 151.91, -4.6% from its open, with a WSJ report of an SEC probe and a delayed 10-Q this morning) and SMH is 468.00 -> 455.35 (-2.7% from its open, -1.0% on the day), back under 458 after its 10:00 bounce failed. TSM is the weakest chip mega cap below its open that is still inside the 3% line and outside a report window: 367.78 -> 358.18 (-2.6%, the +2.3% gap gone, now -0.4% on the day; line 356.75). SPY is at its session low (-0.76% from its open), bonds are bid (TLT +0.7%). Against it: no news of TSM's own since the bell; it is only 0.4% above the 3% line, so this is close to a chase; SMH is sitting on its 10:00 low (453.83) and a second hold there would bounce it; the 20-year auction (13:00) and FOMC minutes (14:00) can turn the afternoon. TSM's nearest expiry is Friday. Shadow only. Wrong if TSM is back above 364.17 or SMH above 461.76 (their 10:17 prices) by 13:16.
picks.catalyst_zh: 看跌镜像按 10:17 写好的价位触发了：英伟达财报超预期却从开盘一路被卖（比开盘低 4.6%，今早还有证监会调查的报道），芯片板块高开 2% 后现在比开盘低 2.7%，10 点的反弹没站住。台积电是还没跌过 3% 线的芯片大盘股里最弱的（比开盘低 2.6%），选它看跌。风险：台积电自己没有坏消息，离 3% 线只差 0.4%，接近追跌；板块正踩在 10 点的低点上，守住就会反弹。只记影子，信心 0.25。

opportunities.why_zh: 看跌镜像的候选：英伟达财报后芯片高开 2%，开盘半小时跌了 3% 又反弹，半导体 ETF 现在比开盘低 1.3%。台积电是没跌过 3% 线的芯片大盘股里最弱的（应用材料更弱，但它今早有券商唱多，且是我们早上看涨的那只，跳过）。不选：台积电开盘后没有自己的坏消息；11:21 按写好的价位再判断。
